ttresearch.page.BLOOD_SWORD.0:
You created a sword that strikes with unparalleled force. However, for this to be the case, the sword feeds on the striker's blood.

Upon damaging anything with this sword, the attacker will take one heart of damage.

Furthermore, simply holding this sword gives the holder a steadfast aura, making them move faster than normal.
ttresearch.page.SUMMON.0:
You are able to use the souls gained from a Cursed spirits blade in order to summon mobs. Place three pedestals around a Tablet of Necromancy. On the pedestals, place three soul aspects. Different types of soul aspects give different types of mobs. Every mob has a different composition.

Nine identical soul aspects in a crafting grid condense into one Condensed Soul Aspect.
